For the 175B SFT model, the paper uses:

- **Learning rate:** 5.03e-6 (p. 40)
- **Batch size:** 8 (p. 40)
- **Epochs:** 16 (p. 40; also stated in Section 3.5, p. 8)

Other training details:
- Residual dropout is 0.2 (p. 8, p. 40).
- The learning rate follows a cosine schedule that decays to 10% of its starting value, with no warmup (p. 40).
- The learning rate was chosen by a geometric search over 5 values for 175B. The number of epochs was also tuned by geometric search (p. 40).
- The final model was selected by reward model score, not validation loss (p. 40).
- SFT models overfit on validation loss after 1 epoch. Training longer still improved RM score and human preference ratings (p. 8).

**Don't confuse this with the PPO initialization model.** The supervised model used to start RLHF training was trained differently (p. 42):
- 2 epochs, with 10% pretraining data mixed in
- Learning rate of 2.45e-6 for 175B
- Batch size of 8 for 175B
